protection.title: What is actually protecting this lesson

badge.openDetails: Show what is protecting this lesson

protection.expiresIn: The link on this page stops working in about {{minutes}} minutes, and is replaced automatically while you watch.
protection.externalNotice: The academy links to this content rather than hosting it, so none of the measures below apply to it.

signedUrl.yes: Your access is checked before this content is handed over.
signedUrl.no: The academy does not check access to this content.

boundToSession.yes: The delivery service re-checks your sign-in on every request.
boundToSession.no: The delivery service does not re-check your sign-in once playback has started.

boundToDevice.yes: The delivery service re-checks this device on every request.
boundToDevice.no: Playback is not tied to this device: the link would work on another device until it expires.

revocable.yes: Access can be withdrawn immediately, before the link expires.
revocable.no: Access cannot be withdrawn before the link expires.

originRestricted.yes: Playback is restricted to this academy’s own websites.
originRestricted.no: Playback is not restricted to this academy’s websites.

watermark.yes: Your account is shown over the video.
watermark.no: No watermark is drawn over this content.

protection.noDrm: There is no DRM. Nothing here prevents screen recording.
protection.limits: No content can be made impossible to copy. These measures check who you are and keep links short-lived; they do not stop screen recording, and the academy does not claim they do.

network.title: We could not reach the academy
network.description: Check your connection and try again. Nothing you have done has been lost.

expired.title: This lesson’s link has expired
expired.description: Links are short-lived on purpose. Try again to get a fresh one.

accessEnded.title: Your access to this course has ended
accessEnded.description: Its content can no longer be opened. Contact the academy if you think this is a mistake.

deviceLimit.title: You have reached your device limit
deviceLimit.description: This browser is not one of your registered devices, and all of them are in use.

sessionConflict.title: You are already learning on another device
sessionConflict.description: Only one device can learn at a time. Continue here to end the other session, or carry on where you left off.

rateLimited.title: Too many requests
rateLimited.description: You are opening content faster than we can check your access. Wait a moment, then try again.

scheduled.title: This activity has not opened yet
scheduled.description: It becomes available on the date the academy scheduled for it. The course outline shows when.

suspended.title: Your account is suspended
suspended.description: Course content cannot be opened while an account is suspended. Contact the academy.

notAuthenticated.title: Please sign in again
notAuthenticated.description: Your session has ended. Sign in to this academy again to carry on.

processing.title: This lesson is not ready to play yet
processing.description: Its video may still be processing. Try again in a few minutes, and tell the academy if it does not appear.

unavailable.title: This activity cannot be opened
unavailable.description: It may have been unpublished, or it may not be part of your enrolment. The course outline shows everything you can open.

unknown.title: Something went wrong
unknown.description: This activity could not be opened. Try again, and contact the academy if it keeps happening.

noContent.title: This lesson has no content yet
noContent.description: The academy has not added anything to this lesson. It is not a fault on your side and there is nothing to retry — you can carry on with the next activity, and the academy can add the content at any time.
